lag_seconds.description: Delay capture by this many seconds to allow points to arrive before their timestamps are read.
lag_seconds.title: Lag Seconds

lookback_hours.description: Re-read this many hours before the newest captured point on every poll to capture late points and field updates. An explicit Start Date limits re-reading; an omitted Start Date does not. Zero disables re-reading. Repeated points merge by series and time.
lookback_hours.title: Lookback Hours

ssl_ca_certificate.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate or certificate bundle to trust in addition to public certificate authorities.
ssl_ca_certificate.title: SSL CA Certificate

ssl_skip_verify.description: Skip certificate and hostname verification for HTTPS connections. Use only for trusted networks with self-signed certificates; prefer an SSL CA Certificate.
ssl_skip_verify.title: Skip SSL Verification

access_token.description: Your database token, sent with the Bearer authorization scheme used by InfluxDB 3.
access_token.title: Database Token

username.description: Your InfluxDB username for HTTP Basic authentication.
username.title: Username

url.description: The URL of your InfluxDB 2.x instance, including the scheme and port if needed.
url.title: URL

token.description: Your InfluxDB API token with read access to the buckets you want to capture. Provide either this token or Authentication credentials.
token.title: API Token

credentials.description: Optional Basic or Bearer authentication instead of an API token. Username & Password works only with a native InfluxDB 1.x server with Flux enabled; compatibility with specific 1.x versions has not been verified. InfluxDB 2.x OSS and Cloud v1-compatibility usernames and passwords are not accepted on /api/v2/query; use an API token there. Your endpoint must still support the v2 Flux query API.
credentials.title: Authentication

org.description: The name of your InfluxDB organization.
org.title: Organization

start_date.description: Capture points with timestamps on or after this date, with nanosecond precision. When omitted, initialize the cursor 30 days before the first run; lookback may read earlier and follows the saved cursor after restarts. Dates before InfluxDB's minimum time (1677-09-21T00:12:43.145224194Z) start at that minimum. Enable a lookback window to capture late points and field changes near the cursor.
start_date.title: Start Date

interval.description: Interval between updates for this resource.
interval.title: Interval

bucket.description: Your InfluxDB bucket name. Omit both bucket and measurement to parse a legacy resource name at its last dot.
bucket.title: Bucket

measurement.description: Your InfluxDB measurement name, including any dots.
measurement.title: Measurement
